Its 'Fuente · Unidad 5' role is still correct because L378 sits under the U5 'Fuentes' heading. Defensible inference, but the only exit not fully literal.
(c) The Sade node pairs 'Los crímenes del amor (Akal, 1994)' with 'orig. Idée sur les romans (Ducros, 1970)' — both citations literal (L233, L234), but that 'orig.' is the original of the chapter, not of the volume (whose original is Les crimes de l'amour). The 'Bordeaux' place of publication is dropped.

Incompleteness, not an error — the node's policy is to register contradictions unresolved, and adding this would still not resolve it.
